title: The Home page, next version — round 2, sixth look

steps.path: Pages → Home, Now playing on the TV, soundbar and speaker
steps.headline: Volume sits inside Now playing, above previous/play/next, with − and + either side of the bar; the Playing line under the name is gone.
steps.changed: Speakers and the soundbar have the same layout. On the TV the bar is the soundbar's volume, because the TV's sound plays there.
steps.notice: Dragging is smooth now: the speaker follows while you drag, and the 5-second check never makes the bar jump under your finger.
steps.risk: A TV with no linked soundbar has − and + only, no bar: the TV box cannot say how loud it is.

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room TV, Remote
steps.headline: The remote is one card: a Remote header with a remote-shaped icon opens it, and the remote sits inside that same card.
steps.changed: The separate bar and separate remote box are now one container, like the lights card. The icon is a TV remote's shape.
steps.notice: Closed, it is just the header row; the arrow flips when open.

steps.headline: A TV links its volume to a soundbar only when there is no doubt, or when you choose it in Edit.
steps.changed: Stated, not asked: automatic only when the room has exactly one soundbar and exactly one TV with a paired remote. Otherwise nothing is linked. In Edit, each TV has a Sound list: automatic (it shows what it found), the TV itself, or any soundbar or speaker in the room. Your choice always wins.
steps.notice: Destin's Room links automatically: one soundbar, one paired TV. The Samsung TV shows automatic (none).

steps.headline: The whole page responds better: buttons ease and press in slightly, slider handles show on hover and grow while held, nothing redraws needlessly.
steps.changed: Stated, not asked: each part of the page now redraws only when something in it changed, so a hovered button stays hovered, the text box you are in keeps focus, and camera pictures stop reloading every 5 seconds. Brightness also follows while you drag.
steps.notice: Try it in the test app: this is about feel, which pictures cannot show. Reduced motion in your system settings turns the movement off.
